It was refused once read. The Pro Max listing names itself in its own details table — Brand AIPER, Model Name 'Scuba X1 Pro Max' — and Aiper publishes a matching page, so this identity rests on published fields rather than on a URL that looked like confirmation. Every observation the Essential's record held was removed rather than carried across.
